summary: The archived global Samsung For Tomorrow grant could not be verified. Samsung does publish a distinct Solve for Tomorrow US school competition for 2026–27.

sources.title: Samsung Solve for Tomorrow 2026–27 announcement
sources.supports: US school competition opens September 30 and closes November 23, 2026; teachers apply for grade 6–12 students.

notes: This is a school STEM competition, not a global founder grant. No successor relationship with the archived grant is claimed.
The related US competition offers school technology/resources; final event is April 2027 without an exact date.
Other countries run separate eligibility rules and schedules.
